text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Come at me, tin can. Or rather, newly 
spawned base unit.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
That is, if you wish to eventually attain 
the status of Machine God!

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text: Mhm, let us go, Gimlet.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: TAAAAAAAAHHH!!

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text: Ngggh...
(CLANK, CLANK)

Development has only just begun. At this 
point, ST-2 can't keep up at all. 
Meanwhile...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Phew, looks like it's finally coming 
together. By the way, what about the 
materials you said you'd prepare...?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: That helps. Let me write that down too...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
What do you think, Doctor? Do you think 
you can make good use of that file?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Here's the running data for the five of 
us. It's detailed and broken down, so you 
can compare each mini-sector.

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
Incredible... With this, we can see at a 
glance exactly where and how far behind 
ST-2 is falling.

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
Not only the training course, but every 
single racetrack is covered too. This is a 
lifesaver... an absolute lifesaver...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
The Trainer here also helped me collect 
them. I intend to do everything I possibly 
can.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Professor, we will definitely reach it. 
The exact same speed as an Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
See you later. I'll bring over the new 
materials once they're ready.

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Biwa Hayahide, Trainer.

Later on, I spotted Biwa Hayahide 
desperately pouring over reference books 
in the library.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"This book... overlaps with the previous 
materials. No, perhaps there's another 
interpretation..."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Somehow, I need to translate the running 
of top-class Umamusume into mechanical 
data.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
The only ones who can build that bridge— 
are us.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
It's you. I appreciate the concern, but 
I'm not particularly tired.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I really want to get ST-2 running at high 
speeds somehow. Someday, without fail.

Biwa Hayahide was always cool-headed. Yet, 
the sheer passion she was putting into it 
felt a bit uncharacteristic of her.
choice_data_list: Do you like robots that much?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hm? I like it, sure... Just not crazy 
about it, is all.
choice_data_list: So you like Dr. Lights, huh?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. They're intellectual and we get along 
well, but it's not like I've taken a 
special liking to them or anything.
choice_data_list: Then why are you taking it so seriously?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. I completely understand getting 
carried away, because her—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: It's a “sense of loss,” indeed.

A “sense of loss”... Those words alone 
don't reveal much, but...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I experienced it in the past as well. A 
setback just like that.
(Craaaaaash!!)

text_block_list.name: Young Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Big sis? Open your eyes. Big sis! Big 
sis!!
(Wee-woo... wee-woo...)

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I suffered a severe injury when I was 
young. Right in front of my younger 
sister, Narita Brian's eyes.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Of course, they told me it would heal 
completely. And yet...

text_block_list.name: Young Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
(What if... what if I really can't run 
anymore...?)

text_block_list.name: Young Hayahide
text_block_list.text: (U-Uuuugh...)

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Never being able to run again. That 
fear... might be something only an 
Umamusume could truly understand.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
The act of running. For us Umamusume, it 
is—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: It is synonymous with living.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
If I had to describe it... it feels like 
I'm unable to breathe, day in and day 
out...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
A feeling of walking endlessly through the 
darkness... That's the kind of mood it 
puts me in.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Fortunately, I was able to overcome it. I 
could run just as well as before. 
However...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
To think of how much despair Dr. Wright 
must feel, now that he's truly unable to 
run...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I... understand. That's why...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I want to show her, no matter what. A 
light that matches all the suffering she's 
been through.

—An Umamusume who lost her running. Dr. 
Wright's suffering doesn't feel like 
someone else's problem to Biwa Hayahide.

As a human, I might never be able to 100% 
understand how she feels. However—
choice_data_list: Let's do it, no matter what it takes

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Hm? You...
choice_data_list:
Let's make sure ST-2 can run again, no 
matter what.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, everyone worked together. Thanks 
for... reading the room.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Could you go check the shelf over there, 
then? Thanks.

The two of us nod in agreement. And so, 
together with Biwa Hayahide, I set to work 
on preparing even more materials.
